# AccessKit Android

Source: `accesskit_android` 0.7.4 from crates.io, maintained by the
[AccessKit project](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit).

This local distribution retains the upstream MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.
It supports Android `ACTION_SET_TEXT` through AccessKit's `SetValue` action
and uses signed indices for text-change events, including empty text.
